papers.title: Nirvāṇa as an exit condition
papers.subtitle: A formal model of liberation under the simulation hypothesis
papers.summary: If we are simulated agents and craving is what keeps us being run, nirvāṇa is coherently the one exit. But escape and deletion look identical from inside, so the hypothesis cannot be tested as stated.

papers.title: The NPC's problem
papers.subtitle: If the characters in a game became sentient, could they discover the world that runs them?
papers.summary: An outside-steered character is unmasked after about 1/λ² observed choices, where λ is how often it leaks outside knowledge. But a world can leak nothing, and every leak ours has been searched for came back empty.
